en: Do you remember Rosa's birthday? (to a friend)

en: Vale, have you seen the candles yet?

en: Can I help with anything?

en: Where's the cake?

en: In the kitchen, don't touch it yet. (to a friend)

en: Not yet, but he's on his way.

en: Shall we close the door?

en: No, wait for her to come in. (to a friend)

en: Good luck with the contract.

en: Thanks, we're going to sign it today.

en: Did everything go well?

en: Yes, we're partners now.

en: Congratulations, partner!

en: Congratulations to you both! How nice.

es: Gracias, de verdad.
en: Thank you, really.

en: The fine arrived today.

en: Oh no. How much is it?

en: It's a lot, but we'll see.

es: ¿Qué hacemos ahora?
en: What do we do now?

en: Check everything and talk to a lawyer.

en: Don't worry, we'll get out of this. (to a friend)

en: I hope you're right. (to a friend)

en: Who called?

en: It was Hernando. The Mono died last night.

en: Oh, what a shame. And Hernando?

en: He's at the café, he hasn't said anything.

en: Hernando, I'm so sorry.

en: Thanks, son. He was my best friend.

en: I'm here, sir. I'm listening.

en: Thanks. I don't want to be alone today.

en: I'll go with you to the funeral, if you want. (to a friend)

en: It would help me a lot, to be honest.

en: What do I write to the family?

en: Something short: my deepest condolences.

en: And if I don't know what to say?

en: Just being there is enough.

en: Hernando kept all my cards.

en: Rosa wrote them with a lot of affection.

en: Are they all Christmas ones?

en: Almost all, and one birthday card.

en: Merry Christmas, son. Come in, there are buñuelos.

en: You too, and may it be better than this one.

en: Are you all coming to the novena tomorrow?

en: Of course, we'll bring the little candles.

en: How was the wedding?

en: Beautiful, everybody cried.

en: And the baptism?

en: Very nice. The baby girl didn't cry.

en: What good news, congratulations.

en: I have news from Cali.

en: Good or bad?

en: Good, my nephew was born.

en: How nice! Congratulations to your sister.

es: Se las doy de tu parte.
en: I'll pass them on from you.

en: Yes, it was just the fright.

en: Tell me. (to a friend)

en: Shall we have a coffee?

en: Gladly, I'm coming shortly.

es: Estás cansado, Tomás.
en: You're tired, Tomás.

es: Es que no dormí bien.
en: It's just that I didn't sleep well.

es: Ojalá puedas descansar este fin de semana.
en: I hope you can rest this weekend. (to a friend)

es: Eso espero.
en: I hope so.

es: De nada. Para eso son los socios.
en: You're welcome. That's what partners are for.

es: Y nosotros por ti.
en: And we are for you.

es: Tú puedes, Tomás.
en: You can do it, Tomás.

es: Voy a seguir adelante.
en: I'm going to keep going.

es: Que Dios te escuche.
en: May God hear you. (to a friend)

en: With pleasure, young man.
